# Project Overview

This is a Job Application Tracker.

## Stack
- Java 17
- Spring Boot
- MongoDB
- Thymeleaf
- Bootstrap 5.3.2

## Architecture
- Controller
- Service
- Repository
- Model

## Database
MongoDB database: tracker

## Rules
- Do not introduce JPA/Hibernate.
- Use MongoDB repositories.
- Do not introduce another frontend framework.
- Preserve existing authentication.
- Prefer simple implementations suitable for a learning project.
- Do not rewrite working code unnecessarily.
- Explain important Java/Spring concepts when asked.
- Before modifying files, inspect the existing implementation.
- Run the build/tests after significant changes.
